game: Robinson Crusoe: Adventures on the Cursed Island (1st ed.)
detail: The most-cited bad rulebook in the hobby. Designer Ignacy Trzewiczek has acknowledged serious errors; vague descriptions leave when/how actions can be taken unclear; inconsistent graphic design compounds it. Spawned a large fan FAQ/errata ecosystem.
source: 4 terrible board game rulebooks that really don’t rule – Going Analog
